crossRefs.note: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be…
“The bows of the mighty men are broken. Those who stumbled are armed with strength.
“Yahweh kills and makes alive. He brings down to Sheol and brings up.
so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.
He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.
He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.
Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.
Who stoops down to see in heaven and in the earth?
For out of prison he came out to be king; yes, even in his kingdom he was born poor.
All the trees of the field will know that I, Yahweh, have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have…
In that day I will raise up the tent of David who is fallen, and close up its breaches, and I will raise up its ruins…
Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary, and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with…
But let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;
and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.
Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

translations.web: He has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted the lowly.
translations.bsb: He has brought down rulers from their thrones, but has exalted the humble.
translations.kjv: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.
translations.asv: He hath put down princes from their thrones, And hath exalted them of low degree.
